name: Default
shortDescription: Open-source e-commerce platform with a storefront and back office, installed automatically on Apache with a bundled MariaDB database.

alerts.message: The back office is at https://<your domain>/<PS_FOLDER_ADMIN>/ (a generated folder name, see the environment). Sign in with ADMIN_MAIL (admin@example.com) and the generated ADMIN_PASSWD, then change the email in your employee profile and configure outgoing email.
